proposal: Percentile-based scenario: increasing benefit up to ~p75-p85 citywide, then flat or mildly declining beyond ~p90-p95 to reflect saturation/operational-constraint concerns.

proposal: Monotonic increasing, concave (e.g. sqrt or log1p of the percentile rank) so the top few extreme-activity cells do not dominate the value function the way raw density would.
parameters_and_caveats: Diminishing returns rationale: marginal suitability gain from 'very high' to 'extremely high' activity is plausibly smaller than from 'low' to 'moderate'.
